# Cline ACP 3.0.55 identity corpus

Secret-free source identity for `cline.acp` before any Swallowtail package
or claim exists.

Official npm `cline@3.0.55` plus GitHub `cli-v3.0.55` ACP sources freeze
the selected stdio wire: `cline --acp`, initialize, `session/new`, one
bounded `session/prompt`, cancel, and joined cleanup.

No live ACP initialize. No provider prompt. No install. No host `cline`.
`--json`, TUI, hub, `--id`, and `--auto-approve true` are not this corpus.

`plan-mode-evidence.json` freezes the ACP Plan selection/confirm seam for
Research 240. It is source identity only; it does not bind production.

No fixture contains a credential, host path, account identity, provider
payload, or real session id.
